cases.explain: Accusative case is used after the verb 'роптали' meaning grumbled

cases.translation: Sent one leader for each tribe
cases.explain: Dative case is used after the preposition 'по' in distributive meaning

cases.translation: Will lead us into this land
cases.explain: Accusative case follows 'в' when indicating direction of motion

cases.translation: Do not rebel against the Lord
cases.explain: Genitive case is used after the preposition 'против' meaning against

cases.sentence: Ваши трупы будут брошены в этой ___
cases.translation: Your dead bodies will be thrown in this wilderness
cases.explain: Prepositional case is used after 'в' when indicating location

cases.sentence: Они порочили перед израилетянами ___ которую разведали
cases.translation: They slandered before the Israelites the land which they had spied out
cases.explain: Accusative case is used as the direct object after the verb 'порочили'
Instrumental case is used with the verb 'быть' in predicate position to express naming

cases.sentence: Сорок лет по году за каждый из ___ дней
cases.translation: Forty years, one year for each of the days

reading.ru: В ту ночь народ поднял крик и громко плакал.
reading.question: What did the people do during that night?
options: They cried out and wept loudly
reading.correct: They cried out and wept loudly
reading.explain: The text states 'народ поднял крик и громко плакал' - the people cried out and wept loudly

reading.ru: Иисус, сын Навин, и Халев, сын Иефониин, которые были среди тех, кто разведывал землю, разорвали на себе одежду.
reading.question: What did Joshua and Caleb do?
options: They ran away from the camp
They tore their clothes in grief
reading.correct: They tore their clothes in grief
reading.explain: The text says they 'разорвали на себе одежду' - tore their clothes, a sign of distress or strong emotion

reading.ru: Земля, через которую мы прошли и которую разведали, необыкновенно хороша.
reading.question: What did Joshua and Caleb say about the land?
reading.explain: Joshua and Caleb stated 'земля необыкновенно хороша' - the land is extraordinarily good

reading.ru: Они лишились защиты, а с нами Господь, не бойтесь их.
reading.question: Why should the Israelites not fear their enemies?
options: Because the enemies' protection was gone and the Lord was with them
reading.correct: Because the enemies' protection was gone and the Lord was with them
reading.explain: Caleb said 'лишились защиты' (lost their defense) and 'с нами Господь' (the Lord is with us)

reading.ru: Ваши дети будут там пастухами сорок лет, страдая за вашу неверность.
reading.question: What would happen to the Israelites' children?
options: They would build cities in the wilderness
They would be shepherds for forty years, suffering for their parents' faithlessness
They would lead the conquest of Canaan
They would become rulers of the desert
reading.correct: They would be shepherds for forty years, suffering for their parents' faithlessness
reading.explain: The text says 'Ваши дети будут там пастухами сорок лет, страдая за вашу неверность' - Your children will be shepherds there forty years, suffering for your faithlessness

reading.ru: Из тех, кто ходил разведать землю, в живых остались только Иисус, сын Навин, и Халев, сын Иефониин.
reading.question: Which spies survived the plague?
reading.explain: The text explicitly states 'в живых остались только Иисус, сын Навин, и Халев' - only Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb remained alive
